- [IRET.1.4a] **Fire-scoped arena.** Transient computed
    strings live in a per-engine slab-chain bump arena, reset at
    pump entry (bounded per pump; the always-runs choke,
    independent of how the prior pump exited). Each dup takes a
    distinct span (no clobber between two live computed strings);
    growth chains a new slab, so a live pointer is never moved.
    An emitted computed string is interned counted at the
    emit-commit, before the reset. `ds.intern.arena_high_water_bytes`
    ([NMET.4]) bounds it.
